entities.summary: Arab Kingdom, a political institution in Syria during French Mandate and Independence (1918–1925). Led to the emergence of Battle of Maysalun — French forces defeat Faisal's army; end of Arab self-rule and Great Syrian Revolt — French forces bombard Damascus.
